title: Russell Brunson Shares 10 YEARS of Funnelhacking Secrets!
description:
In this presentation from Funnel Hacking Live 9.5 (2024), Russell Brunson shares his journey after 10 years of leading ClickFunnels and the Funnel Hacker community.

If you’re an entrepreneur or aspiring to grow your online business, this video offers practical insights into improving your sales funnels, marketing, and business strategies.

Learn why entrepreneurs are key drivers of change, discover how to navigate resistance, and hear strategies that have worked for Russell and countless others.

00:00 – Welcome and Introduction

03:16 – The Funnel Hacker Community
05:20 – Entrepreneurs Are the Real World-Changers
07:19 – You Are the Hero of Your Story
08:33 – The Vision of Entrepreneurs
09:45 – The Calling of Entrepreneurs
12:00 – Overcoming Resistance
17:05 – Big Dreams, Big Resistance
19:39 – Avoiding the Shadow Calling
22:46 – Finding Your Reason for Being (Ikigai)
27:13 – The Art of Making Money with Offers
38:03 – Why the Most Offers Win
43:10 – Creating Offers with High Value
50:47 – Building a Complete Offer Stack
51:58 – You’re Just One Funnel Away

SUBSCRIBE HERE: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2qUDKqTsz00csykCYgdLuA?sub_confirmation=1

WHO IS RUSSELL BRUNSON?
Over the past 20 years, Russell has built a following of over a million entrepreneurs, sold hundreds of thousands of copies of his books (making him a New York Times Bestselling Author), popularized the concept of sales funnels, and co-founded the software company called ClickFunnels that helps tens of thousands of entrepreneurs quickly get their message out to the marketplace.

As of 2023, Russell’s training, teaching, and software has helped over 2,825+ people to make it into the prestigious “Two Comma Club” - meaning they’ve grossed over 7 figures inside of a single sales funnel!
